name: 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon

releases.name: 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon

description.text: 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon, released on 16 September 2026 for the Pokémon Card Game's 30th anniversary: two ready-built decks, one around Espeon ex and one around Umbreon ex, so two players can battle straight away. Espeon ex's attack does 30 damage for each of your Pokémon in play, and Umbreon ex's does 140 more when the opponent's Active Pokémon is already damaged. Damage counters and markers, coins, a paper full-size playmat in a 30th-anniversary design and a tin double deck case came with them. The cards, basic Energy included, carry a 30th-anniversary Pikachu mark, and full-illustration Victini, Zeraora, Espeon ex and Umbreon ex are numbered past the printed 40.

description.text: One of four full-illustration cards in the 30th CELEBRATION Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon, released on 16 September 2026, all numbered past the printed 40. The Espeon ex deck held it beside the regular Victini, with a full-illustration Espeon ex; the Umbreon ex deck held full-illustration Zeraora and Umbreon ex. In English the same art is the promo of the 30th Celebration Battle Deck—Espeon ex.
